svg.title: Transcript versus full alternative
svg.desc: Compares a transcript and a full alternative for the failure scene. The transcript of dialogue and sounds contains only two warning beeps. The alternative enhanced with visual description includes the security check failure message, retry button, and warning beeps. Audio description conveys visual information through sound alongside the original audio, while a media alternative conveys screens, dialogue, and sounds in text in the same order.

g.font-family: Noto Sans KR, Noto Sans KR Variable, Apple SD Gothic Neo, sans-serif
g.text: Compare directly what is missing from the same failure scene.
Adding visual information to a transcript can yield a sufficient media alternative.
Original audio + needed visual description → understood through sound. No duty to retranscribe original audio.
Screen + dialogue + meaningful sounds → understood through text in the same order.
Check actual content and access paths, not just the format's name.
Audio description can also convey all necessary visual information.
If dialogue is dense, consider extended description or description-integrated narration.
